description: Single fail-closed source of truth for the Claude model+effort used by every Fable-seat consumer (operator TUI, Discord bridge, acceptance pass, cron medic, resume helpers). Read at invocation time. No consumer may hard-code a model.

rules.rollback_to_fable_requires: official included-access restored OR explicit operator paid approval
rules.fail_closed_on_missing_or_corrupt_policy: pause model-dependent lane, keep deterministic monitors, alert ops — never default to a paid or arbitrary model

succession.ruling: claude-opus-4-8 xhigh replaces claude-fable-5 before included-plan sunset

seat_overrides_note: Native Hermes bridge remains the separate Fable 5.1/xhigh acceptance identity. Design and unclassified review requests never use an Astra substitute. Only explicitly NON-DESIGN REVIEW requests may use the previously authorized stand-in. Defaults use native Opus 5.5/medium; the orchestrator chooses effort per task. Retired cutover history is not execution authority. No paid fallback or reset redemption.
